purpose: To advertise the notice for getting a special resolution passed by postal ballot to vary the terms of contracts referred to in the prospectus or alter the objects for which the prospectus was issued.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Simultaneously with dispatch of Postal Ballot Notices to Shareholders
steps: Draft the notice of the proposed special resolution containing the required particulars including reasons, justifications, and risk factors.
Publish the advertisement in Form PAS-1.
Publish the advertisement simultaneously with the dispatch of Postal Ballot Notices to Shareholders.
Place the notice on the website of the company, if any.
checklist: Original purpose or object of the issue
Money utilised for the objects stated in the prospectus
Extent of achievement of proposed objects
Unutilised amount out of the money raised
Reason and justification for seeking variation
Proposed time limit within which varied objects would be achieved
Clause-wise details as specified in sub-rule (3) of rule 3
Risk factors pertaining to the new objects
watch: The advertisement must be published simultaneously with the dispatch of Postal Ballot Notices to Shareholders.
